coach_briefing: The three files likely capture the same ~25-minute outing despite an approximately one-hour mobile-clock offset. Use SpeedCoach as the working record: 3915 m in 25:25.8 at 22 SPM. There is a distinct 21:00–22:00 rate/speed rise (27.7 SPM, 3.145 m/s), but without the session plan it cannot be judged as intended or off-target. Boat context, physiology, technique, and environmental effects remain unevaluable.

SpeedCoach reports 3915.3 m. Mobile raw GPS maxima are reasonably close at 3955.6 m and 3974.0 m, whereas each mobile reported summary distance conflicts materially with its own raw distance and with SpeedCoach.

Both mobile routes show small nearest-route distances in both directions against the SpeedCoach route. SpeedCoach is selected as the reference route rather than combining GPS traces.
